uncited: MinkowskiBroadcast is a scattered assignment operation that propagates a single global feature vector (reduced to the origin) to all coordinates in a sparse tensor.
It solves the problem of attaching global context to local sparse features without altering the coordinate structure.

It differs from sibling methods like [MinkowskiBroadcastAddition](4204-scattered-assignment.md#minkowskibroadcastaddition) and [MinkowskiBroadcastMultiplication](4204-scattered-assignment.md#minkowskibroadcastmultiplication) by performing a pure copy operation, whereas those variants apply element-wise arithmetic.
It is distinct from [MinkowskiBroadcastConcatenation](4204-scattered-assignment.md#minkowskibroadcastconcatenation), which expands the feature dimension rather than replacing it.
- Input 1: `input`, a `SparseTensor` with coordinates $\mathcal{C}^\text{in}$ and features $\mathbf{x}_1$.
- Input 2: `input_glob`, a `SparseTensor` containing global features $\mathbf{x}_2$ reduced to the origin.
- Output: A `SparseTensor` with the same coordinates $\mathcal{C}^\text{out} = \mathcal{C}^\text{in}$ and broadcast features $\mathbf{y}$.
- `input_glob` must contain exactly one feature vector per batch index present in `input`.
Broadcasts reduced global features to all input coordinates by adding them element-wise to the input sparse tensor features.
The output coordinates are identical to the input coordinates.
It is chosen when global context should be added as a bias or residual to local features.
Broadcasts reduced global features to all input coordinates by multiplying them element-wise with the input sparse tensor features.
The output coordinates are identical to the input coordinates.
It is chosen when global context should modulate local features (e.g., attention-like gating).
Broadcasts reduced global features to all input coordinates and concatenates them to the input features along the feature dimension.
It is chosen when both local and global features need to be preserved and processed jointly in subsequent layers.
MinkowskiBroadcast is part of the MinkowskiEngine library, which implements sparse tensor operations for 3D deep learning.
It is designed to work with sparse tensors where features are reduced to the origin (global pooling) and then broadcast back to the original sparse coordinates.
